label_model: latent physicochemical scores; binary = score>0; multiclass = argmax of class latent scores (toxicity_type: 0 = non-toxic); regression = latent HC50. neurotoxicity_type & HC50 are PARTIAL (NaN = unlabelled).
data_origin: synthetic_demo (NOT experimental data); external rows keep their own origin
partial_labels: NaN cell = endpoint not measured for that row (pepADMET convention)
